AWS DevOps Agent recommends fixes. It doesn’t apply them. Setup doesn’t enable Directed Actions or elevated permissions, so findings and fixes stay recommendations that you review and decide whether to act on.

You can say `stop` during setup to roll back what the skill created. After setup, you can pause, stop, or check the cost of AWS DevOps Agent. Stopping cancels in-progress work but keeps your setup.

AWS Startup Advisor is available at no additional charge, but AWS DevOps Agent is a paid AWS service. If you have AWS Activate credits, they can cover your AWS DevOps Agent usage. For pricing information, see AWS DevOps Agent pricing

For the AWS Startup Advisor IDE extension equivalent, see Operate.

Example prompt: "Our API has been returning 502s since the last deploy — what broke?"

results.title: Getting started with AWS Startup Advisor - AWS Startup Advisor
results.content:
`claude plugin install aws-startup-advisor@claude-plugins-official`

The `claude-plugins-official` marketplace is added to Claude Code by default.

If you get `Plugin not found`, update the marketplace index first. In Claude Code, run the following command:

`/plugin marketplace update claude-plugins-official`

Alternatively, you can install the plugin from the Agent Toolkit for AWS repository’s own marketplace. In Claude Code, run the following commands:

`/plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws /plugin install aws-startup-advisor@agent-toolkit-for-aws /reload-plugins`

Use this alternative to get the newest version from the Agent Toolkit for AWS repository on GitHub as soon as it’s released, before it reaches `claude-plugins-official`. Install from one marketplace, not both.

## What is AWS Startup Advisor?

AWS Startup Advisor is your AI-powered build assistant, available as an extension for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and Kiro or as a standalone experience on the web. It gives you and your coding agents tailored guidance on AI, architecture, costs, credits, security, and migration, matched to your startup's stack and stage. Whether you're starting from an idea or moving an existing app to AWS, it meets you where you build and adapts its recommendations as your startup grows. AWS Startup Advisor doesn't store your code or share your data with third parties.
